name: Sumitomo Corporation
summary: Sumitomo Corporation engages in the general trading business. It operates through Steel; Automotive; Transportation & Construction Systems; Diverse Urban Development; Media & Digital; Lifestyle Business; Mineral Resources; Chemical Solutions; and Energy Transformation Business segments. The company offers steel sheets and tubular products.
